readings.summary: Restore the analyzer so that with SuppressSourceGeneration = true it still reports all validation diagnostics (MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 etc.), while the generation-only diagnostics MsgPack011/016/017 are deliberately skipped and no formatter is generated.
readings.code_difference: The type collector/analyzer still runs validation for types with SuppressSourceGeneration = true, but skips MsgPack011, MsgPack016 and MsgPack017 for them.

readings.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, the analyzer reports all validation diagnostics (MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 etc.) again, while generation-only diagnostics (MsgPack011/016/017) stay unreported and no formatter is generated.
readings.code_difference: The type collector/analyzer still runs validation for suppressed types and emits the validation diagnostics, but skips MsgPack011, MsgPack016 and MsgPack017 for those types.

readers.framing: a QA engineer who has to write acceptance tests for this requirement before any code exists

readings.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, the analyzer reports all validation diagnostics (MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 etc.) but skips generation-only ones (MsgPack011/016/017), while generation stays suppressed.
readings.code_difference: The type collector still runs analysis for suppressed types and emits validation diagnostics, but filters out MsgPack011, MsgPack016 and MsgPack017 for those types.

readings.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, the analyzer behaves exactly as in 3.1.0 and reports every MsgPack0xx diagnostic, including MsgPack011/016/017, while no code is generated.
readings.code_difference: No diagnostics are filtered for suppressed types; the generation-only diagnostics (MsgPack011, MsgPack016, MsgPack017) are also reported.
